extraction.policy_summary: Biocon states it has an equal opportunity policy as per the Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016, embedded in its Code of Conduct, and pursues a DEI strategy that explicitly includes Persons with Disabilities (PwD) alongside gender, LGBTQIA+, veterans and other groups, supported by inclusive hiring practices, workplace accessibility assessments, and dedicated ERG support.
extraction.pwd_employee_count_details: Biocon Limited: 21 differently abled employees (0 permanent, 21 other-than-permanent) out of 4,184 total employees; 0 differently abled workers out of 1,077 total workers. Biocon Biologics: 6 differently abled employees out of 5,627 total employees; 0 differently abled workers out of 870 total workers. Narrative text states 'PwD representation in our workforce included 21 in our Generics business and 6 in our Biosimilars business.'
extraction.physical_accessibility_measures: In the mandated BRSR questions, Biocon answers 'Yes' that its premises/offices are accessible to differently abled employees and workers, and separately 'Yes' that its premises are accessible to differently abled visitors, as per the requirements of the Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016. No specific physical features (ramps, restrooms, elevators, etc.) are described.
extraction.training_or_sensitization_programs: A 'DEI sensitization program' is referenced as part of Biocon's social well-being initiatives, alongside a dedicated Employee Resource Group ('We Stand for PwD'); no detail on training content, frequency, or reach is given.
extraction.recruitment_details: Biocon states it pursues 'inclusive hiring practices' for Persons with Disabilities as part of its DEI strategy, alongside workplace accessibility assessments and ERG support. No numeric hiring targets, attainment rates, or named disability-specific recruitment outreach partners are disclosed.
extraction.culture_practices_details: Biocon operates a dedicated Employee Resource Group, 'We Stand for PwD,' as part of its broader ERG ecosystem (alongside Biocon Women Network, Men Allies Network, etc.), described as providing 'structured community, peer support, and networking across the organization,' plus 'inclusive celebrations' and a DEI sensitization program. No accommodation response-time commitments or other operational culture practices are described.
extraction.compliance_details: Biocon answers the mandated BRSR statutory questions affirmatively: premises/offices accessible to differently abled employees and workers per the Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016 ('Yes'); equal opportunity policy per the RPwD Act, 2016 in place via the Code of Conduct, with a web-link provided; and premises accessible to differently abled visitors per the RPwD Act, 2016 ('Yes').
